translations.web: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.
translations.bsb: By the word of the Lord, we declare to you that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will by no means precede those who have fallen asleep.
translations.kjv: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall ➔ not prevent them which are asleep.
translations.asv: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we that are alive, that are left unto the coming of the Lord, shall in no wise precede them that are fallen asleep.
